passages.note: Bill details digest names Glick as author and McNamara/King as sponsors; it does not name Holdman or show his own act, so it cannot carry his chair.

passages.provision_quote: the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest
passages.note: Enrolled act's IC 16-34-2-1 makes abortion a criminal act except for serious health risk or to save the mother's life, a lethal fetal anomaly, or when the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest; matches the rung's ban-with-exceptions structure.
Senate Roll Call 58 on concurrence with SB 1(ss); Holdman is listed among the 28 Yea votes.

rows.reasoning: Holdman voted Yea on concurrence with SB 1(ss) (2022 Special Session), whose enrolled text amends IC 16-34-2-1 so abortion is a criminal act except when necessary to prevent a serious health risk or save the mother's life, when the fetus has a lethal fetal anomaly, or when 'the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest.' This ban-with-exceptions structure matches the rung text 'ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life.'
